# AIRBabel

> AIRBabel is a sequence-defined reference for immunoglobulin (IG) and T-cell receptor (TR) germline alleles (V, D, J and C segments), their leader sequences and recombination signal sequences (RSSs), across many species. Each distinct sequence has one stable, sequence-derived UID. Every name that IMGT, OGRDB, IUIS, VDJbase and other sources give that sequence is attached to it as a label, so an allele name from any source resolves to the same sequence.

Use AIRBabel to answer: what is the sequence of an allele name (e.g. IGHV1-69*01), which names from different sources refer to the same sequence, whether two names are the same allele, which alleles are similar to a sequence, and where each name and record comes from. Names are labels; the sequence is the identity. Data is aggregated from its sources with attribution; AIRBabel does not adjudicate between them.

## Record pages

- [Allele record](https://airbabel.org/seq/HUMAN-VQLNRZF6P): `/seq/<UID>`, one page per sequence: species, locus, segment, functionality, nucleotide and (for V) amino-acid sequence, every name with its naming scheme and source, cross-references.
- [Search](https://airbabel.org/?q=IGHV1-69*01&mode=auto&species=human): `/?q=<allele name, nucleotide or amino-acid sequence, or PMID>`.
- RSS records are at `/rss/<UID>` and leader records at `/leader/<UID>`.
- [Sitemap](https://airbabel.org/sitemap.xml): every record page.

## REST API (JSON)

- [Resolve a name or UID](https://airbabel.org/api/resolve?query=IGHV1-69*01): `GET /api/resolve?query=<name|uid>`; add `&view=airr` for an AIRR AlleleDescription.
- `GET /api/sequences/<UID>`: a record by UID (supports `?view=airr`).
- `GET /api/sequences/<UID>/aliases`: every name for the sequence, with its scheme.
- `GET /api/search/name?q=<term>&species=<tag>`: fuzzy name search.
- `POST /api/search/sequence` with `{"sequence": "..."}`: nucleotide similarity search.
- `POST /api/search/aa` with `{"sequence_aa": "..."}`: amino-acid search.
- [Version and dataset release](https://airbabel.org/version): software version, dataset digest and source versions, for citation.

## MCP server (for AI assistants)

- `https://airbabel.org/mcp/` (Streamable HTTP, public, no key). Tools: `resolve_allele`, `resolve_sequence`, `get_aliases`, `find_similar`, `get_cross_species_neighbors`. Rate-limited; the two similarity tools have a tighter limit. Setup: [Guide](https://airbabel.org/help#mcp).
